title: The suite has id room for new tests, and workers run the whole suite at most once
goal: the quick unit tests of six test files are merged into fewer ids with every assertion kept, so the suite collects at most 90 test ids; a worker's brief tells a content-only item's worker to run no whole tests.py and a code item's worker to run it at most once, before its report, adding no test id; a full tests.py run on a quiet darwin host still takes at most 23 s
